scope: Static lower bound from source slots and guards; native phi arguments can only increase it. Not a runtime or checker acceptance result.
action: Factor node-entry state checks before extending memory-effect execution coverage to count_fill; do not weaken selection or snapshot equality.

proposed_factorization.shared_metadata: Retain the full ordered argument list and exact argument indices; never drop predecessor states.
proposed_factorization.selection: One relation over all incoming selection booleans enforces exactly one.
proposed_factorization.arrivals: Each separate relation takes the same shared current entry state plus one predecessor selection, guard inputs and snapshot. A selected predecessor must have a true guard and matching assignedness/payload/phis.
proposed_factorization.composition: Conjoin all relations at the same actual indexed values; do not accept unconstrained claimed success booleans. Native execution and application proof composition remain separate.
proposed_factorization.bounds: Validate each emitted component against binder-depth limits before materialization, retain metadata-size and total-term limits, and preserve existing compact single-definition cases byte-for-byte.
proposed_factorization.tests: Run original count_fill source with valid selection, missing/duplicate selection, disabled selected guard, selected snapshot corruptions and inactive predecessor differences; verify exact import reconstruction and same bytes in both checkers.

resolution.scope: Entry representation limit resolved; native loop execution/application proofs remain open.
